_note: The model pool must match the model subset of the Model Router deployments you compare against, and each `deployment` must be the Foundry deployment both arms call. Descriptions are what Decision-1 reads to tell the options apart: review them before use. `tier` orders models by price, 1 = cheapest.

models.name: gpt-5-nano
models.description: Trivial, single-step work: a one-line code change, a lookup, a one-sentence answer, simple classification or extraction.

models.name: gpt-5-mini
models.description: Simple work that needs some care: short summaries, extraction with citations from a few documents, small self-contained functions.

models.name: deepseek-v4-flash
models.description: Low-cost generalist, strongest at code and written content of moderate complexity: modules, tests, refactors, drafts, rewrites, scripted data handling.

models.name: gpt-5.5
models.description: General mid-to-high complexity work: synthesis across many documents, comparison and recommendation, careful writing where wording must be defensible.

models.name: o4-mini
models.description: Deep step-by-step reasoning: multi-step planning, tool orchestration, maths, debugging intermittent failures, cost and capacity models.

models.name: gpt-5.6-terra
models.description: Maximum capability: enterprise strategy, large-scale architecture, regulator-grade analysis, long high-stakes documents.

cost.instructions: Choose the model that should answer the conversation in the state. Cost mode: choose the cheapest model that can still answer well. Prefer a more expensive model only when a cheaper one would likely give a wrong or incomplete answer.

balanced.instructions: Choose the model that should answer the conversation in the state. Balanced mode: weigh answer quality against cost. Prefer a cheaper model when its answer would be about as good as the best model's answer.

quality.instructions: Choose the model that should answer the conversation in the state. Quality mode: choose the model most likely to give the best answer. Ignore cost.
